recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-20649 unless a future Pharmacy decision changes the desired MedicationAdministration search parameter semantics rather than its name.
issue_request: FHIR-20649 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking that MedicationAdministration use the search parameter name "date" instead of "effective-time", harmonizing it with other clinical date search parameters.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies merge commit b60fb4b7d3fe218dfc65fc253645e4c6c79d4708 as the original application. Comparing that merge to its first parent shows the MedicationAdministration spreadsheet search row changed from "effective-time" to "date" while retaining the date type and description.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration remains an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The current source no longer uses the old spreadsheet, and the active per-resource search parameter bundle now defines MedicationAdministration-date with code "date" over MedicationAdministration.occurrence[x]. The linked Zulip thread confirms the request came from the mismatch with other clinical-date parameters, and Confluence/Jira neighborhood searches did not reveal a later reversal or conflicting core decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build source already reflects the requested search parameter name and an explicit search of source found no remaining "effective-time" occurrence.
